title: Container Bookings: surcharge, premium and booking fee rates by tier
content:
## Scope
This rate card covers the Container Bookings product line and lists, for each tier, the peak season surcharge, the equipment imbalance surcharge, how bunker cost is billed, how long a quoted or contract-filed rate stays bookable, the manual booking fee and the loading guarantee premium.

## What each rate means
- **Peak season surcharge**: charged at confirmation, in USD per container; 0.00 means the tier is exempt.
- **Equipment imbalance surcharge**: charged at confirmation, in USD per container; 0.00 means the tier is exempt.
- **Bunker billing basis**: either *included in quote* (no separate bunker adjustment factor row) or *contract BAF schedule* (a separate bunker adjustment factor row from the contract schedule).
- **Rate validity**: the calendar days a quoted or contract-filed booking rate remains bookable after it was issued.
- **Manual booking fee**: the fee per booking placed through the customer service desk, in USD per booking.
- **Loading guarantee premium**: charged at confirmation, in USD per container.

## Rate card
| Tier | Peak season surcharge (USD per container) | Equipment imbalance surcharge (USD per container) | Bunker billing basis | Rate validity (calendar days) | Manual booking fee (USD per booking) | Loading guarantee premium (USD per container) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 400.00 | 175.00 | included in quote | 7 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 400.00 | 175.00 | included in quote | 14 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 0.00 | 120.00 | contract BAF schedule | 30 | 35.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 0.00 | 0.00 | contract BAF schedule | 30 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 250.00 | 175.00 | included in quote | 7 | 35.00 | 185.00 |
| AHL Premium Express | 0.00 | 0.00 | included in quote | 7 | 0.00 | 420.00 |

## Points of judgement
**Which tiers are exempt from the peak season surcharge?** AHL Contract Booking, AHL Contract Priority and AHL Premium Express, whose rate is 0.00.

**Which tiers are exempt from the equipment imbalance surcharge?** AHL Contract Priority and AHL Premium Express.

**Which tiers bill bunker on a separate row?** Only AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority, whose basis is the contract BAF schedule.

**Which tiers carry a loading guarantee premium?** AHL Guaranteed Loading at 185.00 and AHL Premium Express at 420.00 per container; every other tier is at 0.00.
